title: Agent Chat: publish_swf returns base64 SWF to the model (unusable + context bloat) - summarize output / add a compile-check tool
description:
## Problem
The Agent Chat `publish_swf` tool returns the full compiled SWF as a base64 string to the model. The agent uses publish_swf as a de-facto 'compile it / check syntax' step, but the base64 SWF is useless to the LLM (it cannot decode/run it) and it BLOATS THE CONTEXT. Same class of bug as task 1295 (stage_screenshot was delivered as base64 TEXT and fixed with a toModelOutput image content part, scoped via IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS in tools.ts): 'tool output must be model-useful, not raw bytes.'

## JOB 1 - publish_swf return shape (registry + protocol)
- Registry handler: packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts:2003 `async publish_swf(): Promise<PublishSwfResult>` -> calls cb.publishToBytes(), btoa-encodes ALL bytes, returns `{ swfBase64, byteLength }` (registry.ts:2011-2012). swfBase64 = the ENTIRE compiled SWF as base64; byteLength = raw byte count.
- Protocol type: packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts:710-714 `PublishSwfResultSchema = z.object({ swfBase64: z.string(), byteLength: z.number() })`. There is NO warnings/errors field - publish carries no diagnostics at all.
- Description string: packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts:1188 'Compile the document to a SWF (for testing in Ruffle). Returns the SWF bytes/metadata.'

## JOB 2 - confirmed: base64 SWF dumped into model context as TEXT (no toModelOutput)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts:67 `IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS = new Set(["stage_screenshot"])` - publish_swf is NOT in it.
- tools.ts:131-172 only commands in IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS get a `toModelOutput`; everything else (incl. publish_swf) falls to the `else` at tools.ts:170-171 `tool({ description, inputSchema, execute })` with no toModelOutput, so the raw execute() result is serialized as a `type:'json'` tool-result. The entire swfBase64 string lands in the model's text context.
- Size: a tiny golden SWF is ~5.7 KB -> ~7.6 K base64 chars (~2-3K tokens) PER call. Real authored movies with embedded fonts/bitmaps (Magnet.fla scale) are hundreds of KB -> 100K+ base64 chars, easily blowing the context window in a single tool call. The agent typically calls publish_swf repeatedly as a compile/syntax check, multiplying the waste.

## JOB 3 - system-prompt steering + existing lighter validate paths
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/systemPrompt.ts:34 explicitly steers the model: 'To test runtime behavior, publish_swf.' This is the only mention; it does NOT warn that the result is unusable/large, and there is no guidance to prefer a lighter compile-check.
- A LIGHTER per-script validate path ALREADY EXISTS: `script_check` (agent-protocol index.ts:1152, schema 448-451, registry.ts:1644-1645 -> compileCheckScript) returns ONLY `{ diagnostics }` (errors/warnings, no bytes) WITHOUT applying the script. Likewise `class_check` (index.ts:1162, registry.ts:1703-1704 -> parseCheckClass) returns `{ diagnostics }` for AS2 class source. Both are compact and model-friendly.
- GAP: script_check/class_check only check a single AS2 snippet/class. There is NO whole-DOCUMENT compile/validate command (grep for doc_validate/compile_check/validate in agent-protocol = none). So an agent wanting to confirm the WHOLE doc compiles has only publish_swf today - which is exactly why it (mis)uses publish_swf and pays the base64 cost.

## Fix options (mirror task 1295)
(a) Add a `toModelOutput` for publish_swf in tools.ts that returns a COMPACT text summary `{ ok, byteLength, warnings/errors }` and OMITS swfBase64. The user still gets the real SWF via the normal UI publish path (publishToBytes); only the MODEL-facing tool result is summarized. This is the minimal, direct analog of the 1295 IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS toModelOutput fix (could add a SUMMARY_RESULT_COMMANDS set, or a per-command summarizer map).
(b) AND/OR add a dedicated agent-friendly `compile_check` / `doc_validate` command (agent-protocol + registry) that compiles the whole document and returns ONLY diagnostics (no bytes) - the missing whole-doc analog of script_check - then update systemPrompt.ts to point the agent at it for compile/syntax checks instead of publish_swf.
(c) AT MINIMUM, tweak systemPrompt.ts:34 so the model does NOT use publish_swf for validation (reserve publish_swf for genuine runtime testing; tell it to use script_check/the new compile_check for syntax/compile checks).

Recommended: (a)+(c) for the immediate context-bloat fix (smallest, mirrors 1295), with (b) as the proper follow-up so agents have a real whole-doc compile-check that never carries bytes.

## Key files
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts:2003 (publish_swf handler, base64 encode)
- packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts:710-714 (PublishSwfResultSchema), :1188 (description), :1152/:1162 (script_check/class_check)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/tools.ts:67,131-172 (IMAGE_RESULT_COMMANDS + toModelOutput special-casing)
- packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/systemPrompt.ts:34 (steering)
- Reference pattern: task 1295 (stage_screenshot toModelOutput fix)
